preguntas.titulo: What everyone asks before getting started

finPrueba.p: What happens when the 10-day trial ends?
finPrueba.r: Your account moves to the Free plan on its own. It isn't locked, you don't lose any data and you can upgrade whenever you want.

internet.p: Do I need internet to use it?
internet.r: For the web, yes. From your phone you can record animals, vaccines, weighings and pen moves with no signal: they're saved on the phone and sync on their own when the connection comes back.

excel.p: Can I bring over what I already have in Excel?
excel.r: Yes. Upload your spreadsheet as it is and the system recognizes the columns by their names. It only asks about the ones it couldn't identify, and before importing it shows you any errors and duplicates.

privacidad.p: Can another producer see my animals?
privacidad.r: No. Each ranch is kept separate right down to the database, and there are automated tests that try to read another ranch's data and must fail. The assistant can't leave your ranch either.

irme.p: What if I want to leave?
irme.r: Export everything to Excel at any time. If you cancel, your account stays read-only for at least 12 months so you can keep looking up and exporting your information.

cierre.bajada: 10 days with every feature. No card, no commitment.
